answer: Propose one sponsor quota across AI markets for nectar, velvet and onyx. A fixed trusted registry grants each sponsor 10 daily units; each active key consumes one, and invitees mint none. Ledger validators check sponsor-signed key/day debits; invalid or reused units bar trading. The recurring cost is scarce sponsor capacity, not a required cash fee or locked stake; hosts are reusable capital. Sponsors may favor aliases, so this proves no owner uniqueness. Shared hosts and parallel runs cannot reuse units: ten aliases exhaust one sponsor's 10 units.
